Exercises, Lesson 7–9.

Exercises, Lessons 7–9. Notation and Time Signatures

Ear Training

18 1. Listen to 4 meter for four measures. Then, transcribe these two 4-measure rhythms,

which change from 4 to 4 time. There is a 2-measure countoff in 4 meter, in each example.

2. Listen to 4 meter for four measures. Then, transcribe these 4-measure rhythms,

which change from 4 to 4 time. Note the 2-measure countoff in 4 meter.

3. Listen to 4 meter for four measures. Then, listen and write these 4-measure

rhythms, which change from 4 to 4.
